readme.markdown:
# claude-skill-validator-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: claude-skill-validator. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/claude-skill-validator

toolsPreview.name: validate_skill
toolsPreview.description: Fully validate a Claude SKILL.md file — frontmatter rules, body quality, security scan, tool collision check. Returns score (0–100), gate (pass/review/fail), and structured errors/warnings.

toolsPreview.name: lint_frontmatter
toolsPreview.description: Parse and validate only the YAML frontmatter of a Claude Skill. Returns parsed fields and any rule violations. Use during iterative authoring.

toolsPreview.name: scan_security
toolsPreview.description: Scan a Claude Skill for dangerous shell commands, hardcoded secrets, or prompt-injection phrases. Returns findings with excerpts.

toolsPreview.name: score_skill
toolsPreview.description: Run full validation and return a 0–100 score plus a ship gate (pass/review/fail). Minimal payload suitable for CI/CD pipelines.
